import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    
    n = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    
    # Handle edge case where no input
    if len(data) < 2 + n + m:
        return
    
    arr1 = list(map(int, data[2:2+n]))
    arr2 = list(map(int, data[2+n:2+n+m]))
    
    # Merge two sorted arrays in O(n) time
    i, j = 0, 0
    result = []
    
    while i < n and j < m:
        if arr1[i] <= arr2[j]:
            result.append(arr1[i])
            i += 1
        else:
            result.append(arr2[j])
            j += 1
    
    # Add remaining elements
    while i < n:
        result.append(arr1[i])
        i += 1
    
    while j < m:
        result.append(arr2[j])
        j += 1
    
    print(' '.join(map(str, result)))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
